title: AgentReadScreenRequest
description: Params of the agent.readScreenRequest notification (nocx-ljfwz, design §2.4): the server asks the renderer to capture a session's screen. The renderer owns the grid (AD-6), so the frame is produced here, not in the backend. requestId is the broker-minted correlation id the renderer echoes back in agent.readScreenResolved; sessionId is the session whose screen is read — already narrowed by the run's grant before the request was sent; region, when present, is an absolute buffer row span [start, end); absent means the visible screen.

requestId.description: The broker-minted request id; echoed back in the resolution.

sessionId.description: The session whose screen is read (inside the run's grant).

region.description: Absolute buffer row span [start, end). Absent: the visible screen.

start.description: First buffer row of the region, inclusive.

end.description: Last buffer row of the region, exclusive. Must be greater than start.
